known_limitations: GrokBot Office owns supervisory context and coordination policy.
AgentOS owns provider-neutral execution, routing, recovery, and learning.
Workers own bounded execution, not workforce policy.
Human owners retain approval for consequential actions.
primary_visual_metaphor: nodes converging on a coordinating cell
primary_workflow: The goal is not to make every task expensive or to create one bot per role. The goal is to make the next equivalent task cheaper by retrieving the right artifact, reducing context, and keeping the smallest capable team in control.
problem: GrokBot Office is a public-safe reference control layer for a large, external workforce. It keeps the persistent supervisory core small: a small set of Grok supervisors owns intent, context, policy, tradeoffs, and handoffs while replaceable workers do the bounded work.
purpose: Public reference site for the agent workforce architecture.

grokbot-office run validate — tsx src/cli.ts validate
